name: bodyweight overhead triceps extension
description: A triceps extension using your own bodyweight against a stable surface. It targets the back of the arms.
instructions: Place your hands on a bar or sturdy surface at about waist height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean forward in a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body straight.
Press back up by extending your arms and repeat.
